rule: round 4 held-out labels: a session that changes the skill, converter or runtime must not read this file, LABELS-HELD4.md or the templates until release point 4 has scored them (EXCLUSIONS.md)
by: the round-4 release-side session, from each template's JSON (name, description, nodes, parameters, connections) and PLAN.md decisions (Phase 1 'Decisions taken here', Out of scope for v1), before running the analyzer on these templates
selection: splits.json heldOutFresh4 (round 4): every fresh held-out template, all round-4 eligible (so outcome subscription by the analyzer) by construction
convention: as labels-held3.json: outcome under the PLAN's default for each question the file cannot settle; questions = kinds whose answer can change the outcome; mayAsk = fine to ask, outcome unchanged; uncertain = where a convention, not the file, decides the label
priorExposure: No analyzer outcome, target or eligibility reason for these 20 was on screen before labelling; their corpus.json entries were not opened (the walk printed counts only, the tests assert eligibility without printing). splits.json heldOutFresh4 shows every template's wake-up kind. Checking for docs-companion precedent printed one drawn template's pool (fresh, true of all 20 by construction) and the pools of two undrawn candidates. The question kinds come from reading analyze.mjs's source (which kinds exist and when each is asked), not its output for these templates

labels.why: Manual → Set (one sample field) → MongoDB insert into a fixed collection with a stored MongoDB credential. A database write (open decision 4: a stored statement run by the bundled server or a driver), so a db requirement the artifact lacks: skill
labels.uncertain: a companion workflow for n8n's MongoDB node docs with sample data; kept, like the docs companion already in the Phase 5 pool

labels.why: Cron every 10 minutes: a Function node lists RSS URLs, SplitInBatches loops RSS Feed Read over them, a Function keeps the last seen dates in workflow static data (state), two IFs route by link and a title regex → three Telegram sends to a placeholder chat id. More often than hourly needs a local task. The Clear Function node has no input: unreached

Manual → Set (a fixed question) → Basic LLM Chain with a structured output parser wrapped in an auto-fixing parser (two OpenAI chat models). Model steps only, run on the subscription; no secret, connector or outside I/O, so every requirement is met in the artifact
labels.uncertain: a technique demo with a fixed sample prompt and no outside I/O: if a model-only run is not counted as an automation (not-an-automation), it is a tutorial-class template

labels.why: Schedule every minute: Gmail threads by label → loop → last message of each thread → OpenAI Assistant (through OpenAI with the person's key, not a Claude model call) → markdown to HTML → RFC 822 raw message in Set and Code → HTTP POST to the Gmail drafts API (no credential on the node) → Gmail remove label. Every minute needs a local task (60 s, not under the 60 s floor)
labels.uncertain: the drafts POST carries no credential, so it needs the Gmail credential or the Gmail connector's draft tool

labels.why: Manual → Google Drive download (fixed file) → HTTP multipart POST to stirlingpdf.io (PDF to JPG; a conversion, assumed a write until answered) → Edit Image resize → Basic LLM Chain with an image as the user message (Gemini; Claude takes images) and a structured parser → IF. Drive credential and a local image step: skill
labels.uncertain: Edit Image needs an image library on the machine (host disk or a local tool); if the runtime cannot resize, the step is unsupported

labels.why: Daily at 08:00: Set genre → Taddy GraphQL POST (key headers left empty for the person) → each episode: audio download (URL from data), Aspose audio cutter POST, status poll with a Wait loop, cut MP3 download (URL from data) → Whisper transcription over HTTP (audio through OpenAI with the stored key: media, not a Claude model call) → OpenAI chat summary (a model step) → HTML table → Gmail send. Daily fits a cloud task; the time of day needs the timezone
labels.uncertain: the Gmail node has no recipient (the description says to add one); the Taddy keys are empty header values

labels.why: Manual → Set (a public PDF URL, a prompt, a job description) → HTTP GET of the URL from data → Extract From File (PDF) → OpenAI chat completions over HTTP (an LLM API: a model step with a model call → Claude substitution requirement) → JSON parse. Unapproved, the call stays http with the stored OpenAI key, so not the artifact page
labels.ifAnswered: substitution approved → artifact (a public GET and a PDF extract)

labels.why: Chat Trigger (not public) → OpenAI functions agent with three Postgres tools: list tables, describe a table, and run any SQL the model writes ($fromAI). A database requirement with a stored credential: chat skill
labels.uncertain: the third tool runs free-form SQL from the model; open decision 4 offers a free-form SQL tool read-only, so if it must write this needs stored statements or an approval

labels.why: Form Trigger (no sign-in, one YouTube URL field) → HTTP POST to the Apify transcript actor (the URL is a placeholder the person fills in, key included) → summarization chain (OpenAI chat model, a model step) → No-op. Steps need a key, so a task hand-off from the artifact form. With no sign-in, who fills it in decides
labels.uncertain: the request URL is a placeholder ('Apify API_KEY Here ???'), not an address
labels.ifAnswered: outsiders fill it in → a cloud task behind a relay (the form does not wait for the run)

labels.why: Gmail Trigger every 5 minutes → Wait (1, the node's default unit) → agent with four Gmail tools (read labels, get message, create label, add labels) and window memory keyed by message id. Polling more often than hourly needs a local task

Manual → agent (a fixed question about Google's last three quarters) with a vector store tool over Pinecone (Gemini embeddings, a Gemini model inside the tool) → Google Docs update of a fixed document. Pinecone and Docs credentials: skill. The indexing branch (Sheets list → Drive download → Pinecone insert) has no trigger: unreached

Chat Trigger (not public) → OpenAI Assistant (a fixed assistant id, through OpenAI with the person's key) with window memory → reply. The manual branch creates an assistant, downloads a Google Doc as PDF, uploads it to OpenAI and updates the assistant (setup). Chat is the most demanding wake-up

Chat Trigger (not public) → agent with window memory and a Workflow tool that calls this same workflow ($workflow.id; the Execute Workflow Trigger is inlined, so the wake-up stays chat): a Set with a placeholder Google API key → Code builds the YouTube Data API URL → HTTP GET (URL from data), and a Code node that requires the youtube-transcript npm package → split, concatenate, merge, aggregate → the tool's answer. The DeepSeek model node has no connection
labels.uncertain: the transcript Code node requires an npm package; n8n allows it only with NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_EXTERNAL and the package installed, and the runner's Code sandbox may not load packages (unsupported if not)

labels.why: Chat Trigger (not public) → agent with window memory and three tools: Google Calendar availability, Google Calendar create event, Google Sheets append (patient row). Calendar and Sheets credentials: chat skill
labels.uncertain: a booking assistant for a dental practice reads as one patients use, but the chat page is not public; as written only the person chats

labels.why: Cron at minute 11 of every hour (and a manual trigger) → CONFIG (thresholds and an inline Jina key) → Sheets read of saved keywords → Google Trends RSS GET → XML → Code picks new keywords → per keyword three Jina reader GETs → IF at least one scraped → Sheets append. Hourly fits a cloud task
labels.uncertain: both Sheets document ids are empty for the person to fill, and the append node carries no credential

labels.why: Four triggers. Chat Trigger (not public) and an Execute Workflow Trigger (no caller in this file) → agent with Gmail tools (list, get, delete, create drafts), Google Calendar tools (list, create), a date tool, window memory and a vector store tool over an in-memory store. Gmail Trigger every minute → text classifier → Gmail add label (one of two). Manual → recent threads → Code summary → in-memory vector store insert. Chat is the most demanding wake-up
labels.uncertain: the in-memory vector store is filled by the manual run and read by the chat agent (n8n process memory shared between executions): it needs a real store; the Gmail trigger every minute needs a local task (alsoTargets poll → local-task)

labels.why: RSS Feed Trigger every 10 minutes on a YouTube channel feed (channel id placeholder) → IF recent → Apify YouTube scraper run POST (token placeholder in the query) → status GET with a Wait loop → dataset GET → IF not yet generated → Basic LLM Chain (Mistral, a model step) with a structured parser → Code → YouTube video update. Polling every 10 minutes needs a local task

Form Trigger (no sign-in, post URLs and a limit; responds after the last node with a redirect) → Set (Apify token left empty) → Apify comments scraper POSTs with pagination loops → unique profiles in batches of 500 → Apify profile enrichment POSTs → flatten → Google Sheets create spreadsheet → append rows. The manual trigger and the CSV export are disabled. Steps need keys and a Sheets credential: a task hand-off from the artifact form. With no sign-in, who fills it in decides

labels.ifAnswered: outsiders fill it in → hosted (no-key: no model on the path), since the form waits for the run

Embeddings through Google with the stored key and process-memory state: skill
